data.title: Real Madrid vs RB Leipzig, 2 AM on October 22nd: Live stream link, analysis and predictions.
data.content:
RB Leipzig (4-2-3-1): Maarten Vandevoordt; Ridle Baku, Willi Orban, Castello Lukeba, David Raum; Ezechiel Banzuzi, Neil El Aynaoui; Brajan Gruda, Christopher Nkunku, Antonio Nusa; Romulo.

Real Madrid are likely to continue using their familiar 4-2-3-1 system. Vinicius will return to the left wing, while Diomande will have the opportunity to face his former team. Mbappe will continue in the central striker role, supported by Bellingham behind him. [...] Rodrygo is recovering from a knee injury, while Mendy has a hip problem. Asencio is also still recovering from a leg injury. These losses affect squad depth, although Real Madrid still have plenty of alternative options.

The good news is that Vinicius Junior is eligible to play in the Champions League. The Brazilian forward has been included in the squad for the match against Leipzig and is expected to return to the starting lineup. [...] The match will likely see Real Madrid controlling the tempo, while Leipzig look for opportunities on the counter-attack. The quality of the midfield and the ability to capitalize on chances will play a crucial role in determining the outcome.
